# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class IndexFutureRolloverAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2024, 9, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        # Create the mapped continuous Futures symbol.
        self._symbol = self.add_index_future("SPX", data_mapping_mode=DataMappingType.LAST_TRADING_DAY, data_normalization_mode=DataNormalizationType.BACKWARDS_RATIO, extended_market_hours=True)
        # Place a buy order for the mapped continuous Futures symbol.
        self.market_order(self._symbol, 1)

    def on_data(self, slice: Slice) -> None:
        # Create the canonical Futures contract symbol for the current month.
        current_month = slice.time.month
        current_year = slice.time.year
        contract_symbol = Symbol.create_canonical_future(self._symbol.local_symbol, mapping_mode=DataMappingType.EXPLICIT, front_month_offset=0)
        
        # If the contract has expired, it will be replaced by a new contract in the next iteration.
        if contract_symbol != self._symbol and self.portfolio[self._symbol].is_long:
            self.liquidate(self._symbol, tag=f"Rollover {self._symbol.value} -> {contract_symbol.value}")
            self._symbol = contract_symbol

    # Define a custom data mapping mode to roll over to the next month's contract.
    def on_data_mapping_changed(self, previous_mapping: DataMapping, new_mapping: DataMapping) -> None:
        # If the contract has expired, it will be replaced by a new contract in the next iteration.
        if previous_mapping.contract.end_of_last_trading_day and not new_mapping.contract.is_expired:
            self.liquidate(previous_mapping.symbol, tag=f"Rollover {previous_mapping.symbol.value} -> {new_mapping.symbol.value}")
            self.set_holdings(new_mapping.symbol, 1)
